# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_config_doc.py from src/alien/config; do not edit by hand. -->

Every key is validated: unknown keys and out-of-range values fail with the YAML path of the offending entry. Relative paths are resolved against the file that declares them. `alien config show [PRESET|FILE]` prints the effective configuration and `alien config schema` the JSON Schema ([config.schema.json](config.schema.json)). [usage.md](usage.md) explains the options with examples.

Top-level keys:

| Key | Description |
|---|---|
| `extends` | A bundled preset name or another YAML file to start from; mappings merge, lists replace. |
| `project` | Names and locations. |
| `outputs` | What the build writes. |
| `term_id_collisions` | Handling of conflicting term IDs. |
| `sources` | Gene-set sources; at least one is required. Each entry is selected by its `type`. |
| `targets` | Output namespaces (one GMT each). |
| `filtering` | Size and broad-term filters. |
| `redundancy` | Duplicate and overlap removal. |
| `source_priority` | Per family, the order in which source tags win when terms are redundant; `extra.<family>` appends. |
| `gene_mapping` | Symbol resolution options. |
| `hgnc` | HGNC resource location. |
| `ncbi_gene` | NCBI Gene rescue. |
| `ensembl_archive` | Ensembl archive lookups for retired IDs. |
| `runtime` | Parallelism. |

Four keys append to a list instead of replacing it: `gene_mapping.extra_non_gene_tokens`, `gene_mapping.extra_non_gene_token_regex`, `filtering.extra_broad_disease_regex` and `source_priority.extra.<family>`.

## `project`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | `"alien"` | Project label recorded in provenance. |
| `source_dir` | path | `"data/alien_sources"` | Cache directory for downloaded and derived resources (relative to the config file). |
| `outdir` | path | `"data/alien_gmt"` | Output directory; a build is staged beside it and swapped in atomically. |

## `outputs`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `include_symbols` | boolean | `true` | Also write `gmt/symbols.gmt` with HGNC-resolved symbols. |
| `mode` | `full` \| `minimal` \| `gmt` | `"full"` | `full` writes every audit table, `minimal` GMTs plus reproducibility metadata, `gmt` only GMTs and the manifest. |

## `term_id_collisions`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | `rename` \| `error` \| `warn` \| `merge` | `"rename"` | What to do when one `term_id` carries conflicting source metadata (two source terms whose names sanitize to the same ID): `rename` keeps both, the first in sorted identity order keeps the ID and each other one gets a stable `__<hash>` suffix; `error` stops; `warn` and `merge` combine the memberships. Every case is written to `metadata/term_id_collisions.tsv`. |

## `filtering`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min_size_default` | integer | `10` | Remove terms with fewer mapped genes than this, per namespace. |
| `max_size_default` | integer | `500` | Remove terms with more mapped genes than this (families without a specific limit). |
| `max_size_disease` | integer | `500` | Upper size limit for the `disease_phenotype` family. |
| `max_size_cancer` | integer | `500` | Upper size limit for the `cancer_dependency_state` family. |
| `drop_broad_disease_terms` | boolean | `true` | Remove disease terms whose name matches `broad_disease_regex` (such as "cancer" or "disease"). |
| `broad_disease_regex` | list[string] | see `alien config show` | Case-insensitive patterns for broad disease term names; `extra_broad_disease_regex` appends to the defaults. Names are also tried with underscores read as spaces, so `^abnormality of the eye$` matches `HP_ABNORMALITY_OF_THE_EYE`. |
| `exclude_terms` | map[string, mapping] | see `alien config show` | Named rules that remove terms by name before size filtering (reason `excluded_term`, rule name recorded in `removed_terms_size_filter`). Rules merge by name: `{rule: {enabled: false}}` turns one off, a new name adds one. |

## `redundancy`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `exact_duplicate_removal` | boolean | `true` | Collapse terms with identical mapped gene sets before the Jaccard pass. |
| `jaccard_cutoff` | number | `0.85` | Terms with Jaccard similarity strictly above this are redundant. |
| `apply_per_family` | boolean | `true` | Compare terms only within the same family; `false` compares across all families in a namespace. |
| `linkage` | `single` \| `representative` | `"single"` | `single` clusters similar terms transitively; `representative` removes a term only when it is similar to a kept, better-ranked term. |

## `gene_mapping`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `use_hgnc_alias_mapping` | boolean | `true` | Resolve source symbols through HGNC alias symbols (unambiguous aliases only). |
| `min_alias_length` | integer | `4` | For sources in `short_alias_source_tags`, alias-only matches (HGNC alias, case-insensitive alias and NCBI synonym) need at least this many characters. In text-mined libraries short aliases are mostly abbreviations (`HCC` is hepatocellular carcinoma, not HYCC1; `CCT`, `NT3`, `EOS`); rejected tokens are listed in `unmapped_genes` with reason `short_alias_rejected` and the alias match. |
| `short_alias_source_tags` | list[string] | `["DISGENET", "JENSEN_DISEASES_TEXTMINING"]` | Source tags whose alias matches must reach `min_alias_length` (text-mined libraries); `*` applies the rule to every source. |
| `mitochondrial_legacy_symbols` | boolean | `true` | Map legacy mitochondrial-genome names (`ND1`, `CYTB`, `ATP6`, `TRNK`, `TRNL1`, ...) to their `MT-` genes before alias lookup. `COX1` and `COX2` stay ambiguous (they are also aliases of PTGS1 and PTGS2). |
| `excel_date_symbols` | boolean | `true` | Repair gene names that spreadsheets turned into dates (`1-Sep` -> SEPTIN1, `6-MAR` -> MARCHF6); `1-Mar` and `2-Mar` stay ambiguous (MARCHF1/MTARC1, MARCHF2/MTARC2). |
| `case_insensitive_symbols` | boolean | `true` | When no exact current, previous or alias symbol matches, look the symbol up again ignoring letter case (`C1ORF112` finds `C1orf112`); such members get the mapping status `hgnc_case_insensitive_symbol`. |
| `preserve_unmapped_symbols_in_symbol_gmt` | boolean | `true` | Keep source symbols that HGNC cannot resolve in `symbols.gmt` (they are always dropped from Ensembl namespaces). |
| `non_gene_tokens` | list[string] | see `alien config show` | Member names that are not genes (such as "disease") and are dropped with an audit row; `extra_non_gene_tokens` appends. |
| `non_gene_token_regex` | list[string] | `[]` | Patterns for non-gene member names; `extra_non_gene_token_regex` appends. |
| `manual_symbol_repairs` | map[string, string] | `{}` | Source symbol -> HGNC symbol corrections; they override previous-symbol and alias matches but never an exact current symbol. |

## `hgnc`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string \| null | `null` | Override the HGNC complete-set download URL. |
| `archive_date` | string \| null | `null` | Use the dated monthly HGNC archive (YYYY-MM-DD) instead of the current file. |

## `ncbi_gene`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | Use NCBI Gene info and history to rescue symbols HGNC cannot resolve. |
| `allowed_source_tags` | list[string] | `["CCLE", "NCI60", "DEPMAP"]` | Source tags whose memberships may use the NCBI rescue (legacy cell-line libraries by default). |
| `gene_info_url` | string | see `alien config show` | NCBI `Homo_sapiens.gene_info.gz` download URL. |
| `gene_history_url` | string | `"https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/DATA/gene_history.gz"` | NCBI `gene_history.gz` download URL. |
| `use_gene_info_synonyms` | boolean | `true` | Also match NCBI gene synonyms, not only official and historical symbols. |

## `ensembl_archive`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | Look up retired source Ensembl IDs in the Ensembl archive to find their current replacement. |
| `endpoint` | string | `"https://rest.ensembl.org/archive/id"` | Ensembl REST archive endpoint. |
| `batch_size` | integer | `50` | IDs per archive request. |
| `connect_timeout_seconds` | integer | `30` | Connection timeout per request. |
| `timeout_seconds` | integer | `120` | Read timeout per request. |
| `retry_attempts` | integer | `3` | Attempts per batch before the lookup fails. |
| `retry_backoff_seconds` | number | `5` | Base delay between retries (grows exponentially). |
| `unresolved_print_limit` | integer | `20` | How many unresolved archive IDs to log as examples. |

## `runtime`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workers` | integer | `1` | Worker processes for redundancy filtering; `--workers` overrides. |

## `source_priority`

A mapping from family to the ordered list of source tags. Defaults:

```yaml
biology_process_pathway: [H, REACTOME, WIKIPATHWAYS, KEGG_MEDICUS, GOBP]
biology_function_location: [GOMF, GOCC]
disease_phenotype: [HPO, DISGENET, CLINVAR, GWAS_CATALOG, JENSEN_DISEASES_CURATED, JENSEN_DISEASES_EXPERIMENTAL, JENSEN_DISEASES_TEXTMINING]
cancer_dependency_state: [3CA, C4_3CA, C6, C9, CGN, C4_CGN, CM, C4_CM, DEPMAP, CCLE, NCI60]
cell_line_signature: [DEPMAP, CCLE, NCI60]
```

## `filtering.exclude_terms`

Bundled exclusion rules. Each removes matching terms of the listed source tags before size filtering; the removal is recorded as `excluded_term` with the rule name in `metadata/removed_terms_size_filter`. Turn one off with `filtering: {exclude_terms: {<rule>: {enabled: false}}}`.

| Rule | Source tags | What it removes |
|---|---|---|
| `kegg_medicus_variant_and_pathogen` | `KEGG_MEDICUS` | KEGG MEDICUS mutant-variant and pathogen versions of reference pathways (host genes only, near-copies of the REFERENCE pathway). |
| `pathogen_specific_pathways` | `REACTOME`, `WIKIPATHWAYS`, `KEGG_MEDICUS`, `KEGG_LEGACY`, `BIOCARTA`, `PID` | Pathways named after one pathogen; they list host machinery (ribosome, interferon, actin) that other terms already cover. |
| `hpo_modifiers` | `HPO` | HPO modifier and inheritance terms (onset, course, mode of inheritance, age of death): they describe how a phenotype presents, not a phenotype. |
| `experimental_disease_models` | `DISGENET` | Animal-model and transplantable tumour-line terms in text-mined disease libraries. |

## `sources`

Each entry is selected by `type`: `symbol_gmt`, `enrichr_gmt`, `msigdb_tsv`, `canonical_tsv`, `msigdb_cache`, `msigdb_remote`, `enrichr_remote`, `plugin`. Every source also accepts `enabled` (default `true`).

### `msigdb_remote`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `msigdb_remote` | required | `msigdb_remote`. |
| `version` | string | `"2026.1"` | Bundled MSigDB release to download, or a label for a custom `release`. |
| `db_species` | string | `"HS"` | Database species: `HS` (human) or `MM` (mouse). |
| `collection` | string \| null | `null` | MSigDB collection, such as `C2` or `C5`. |
| `subcollection` | string \| null | `null` | Subcollection, full (`GO:BP`) or short (`BP`). |
| `family` | string \| null | `null` | Override the term family. |
| `aspect` | string \| null | `null` | Override the aspect. |
| `cache_dir` | path \| null | `null` | Cache directory (default `source_dir/msigdb_remote`). |
| `force` | boolean | `false` | Re-download and re-extract the archive. |
| `timeout_seconds` | integer | `600` | Download timeout. |
| `release` | mapping | see below | Custom release archive instead of a bundled version. |
| `zip_url` | string \| null | `null` | Shorthand for `release.zip_url`, used with `zip_md5` when no bundled release matches `version`. |
| `zip_md5` | string \| null | `null` | Shorthand for `release.zip_md5`. |

### `msigdb_remote` `release`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `zip_url` | string \| null | `null` | Archive URL; when set, no built-in release fields are inherited. |
| `zip_md5` | string \| null | `null` | Expected archive MD5. |
| `zip_sha256` | string \| null | `null` | Expected archive sha256. |
| `zip_name` | string \| null | `null` | Local file name for the archive (default: from the URL). |
| `summary_rds` | string \| null | `null` | Summary table inside the archive (default: `<zip name>.summary.rds`). |

### `enrichr_remote`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `enrichr_remote` | required | `enrichr_remote`. |
| `libraries` | list[mapping] | required | Libraries to download; a string is shorthand for `{name: ...}`. |

## `targets`

Default: `[{"name": "human_gencode49", "annotation": {"source": "GENCODE", "version": "49"}}]`.

### `targets[]`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `ensembl_gtf` | `"ensembl_gtf"` | Target adapter; only `ensembl_gtf`. |
| `name` | string | required | Namespace name; the GMT is written to `gmt/<name>.gmt`. |
| `annotation` | mapping | required | Primary annotation that maps symbols to Ensembl IDs. |
| `output_genes` | mapping \| null | `null` | The final ID set: only these IDs are written, and IDs absent from the annotation can still be mapped through `symbol_column`. |
| `gene_filter` | mapping \| null | `null` | Restrict annotation IDs to this list. Like `output_genes`, a file path or a list of IDs is shorthand. |

### `targets[].annotation`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string \| null | `null` | Annotation origin; `GENCODE` can be downloaded from `version` alone. |
| `version` | string \| null | `null` | Annotation release, such as `47`. |
| `path` | path \| null | `null` | Local GTF file. |
| `url` | string \| null | `null` | GTF download URL. |
| `file_name` | string \| null | `null` | Local name for a downloaded `url`. |
| `attributes` | mapping | see below | Attribute names when the GTF does not use GENCODE's. |
| `metadata_fallbacks` | list[mapping] | `[]` | Secondary annotations, used in order, only for output genes the primary annotation lacks. |

### `targets[].annotation.metadata_fallbacks[]`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string \| null | `null` | Annotation origin; `GENCODE` can be downloaded from `version` alone. |
| `version` | string \| null | `null` | Annotation release, such as `47`. |
| `path` | path \| null | `null` | Local GTF file. |
| `url` | string \| null | `null` | GTF download URL. |
| `file_name` | string \| null | `null` | Local name for a downloaded `url`. |
| `attributes` | mapping | see below | Attribute names when the GTF does not use GENCODE's. |
| `mode` | `fill_missing_output_metadata` | `"fill_missing_output_metadata"` | Only `fill_missing_output_metadata`: fill metadata for output genes missing from the primary annotation. |

### `targets[].annotation.attributes`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gene_id` | list[string] | `["gene_id"]` | GTF attribute(s) holding the gene ID, tried in order. |
| `gene_name` | list[string] | `["gene_name"]` | GTF attribute(s) holding the gene symbol. |
| `gene_biotype` | list[string] | `["gene_type", "gene_biotype"]` | GTF attribute(s) holding the biotype. |

### `targets[].output_genes / gene_filter`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | path \| null | `null` | Table or list file with gene IDs. |
| `id_column` | string \| null | `null` | Column with Ensembl IDs (`index` for a Parquet row index; default: guessed). |
| `symbol_column` | string \| null | `null` | Optional column with gene symbols, used as an extra mapping helper. |
| `ids` | list[string] \| null | `null` | Inline Ensembl IDs instead of a file. |
